status: Profiled shared allocation cause corrected and qualified across all four host/runtime contexts, installed packages, all SVGWeb originals/contexts and a controlled three-launch quiet repeat. Frozen Windows DejaVu remains the sole unrelated full-suite failure.
cause: Retained sharp rectangle sources reached the axis-aligned rounded-outline lowerer. Its fixed builder allocated the complete four-arc expansion point array even when a zero corner radius emits exactly four points.
correction: Use the exact four-point sharp branch capacity. Rounded branches retain the original bound. All vertices/order, mapping, retained source/paint behavior, cancellation and maximum scratch reservation remain unchanged; no growing buffer or new admission/cleanup path is introduced.

attribution.scope: Local cumulative managed allocation attribution only; no workstation renderer timing claim. Warm eight calls, record 32 calls per case; retain source/font/option setup outside.
attribution.phaseMeaning: Whole direct conversion; prepared creation with an explicit font-free provider/catalog; conversion of that newly prepared document. Disposal is retained. Prepared font-discovery work is a distinct path from direct conversion, so columns are not an additive partition.
attribution.sourceControls: Unchanged committed geometry-rect plus authored ID-removal and viewBox-removal diagnostics; input bytes remain separate and original targets untouched.
attribution.controlPixels: All six after-control PNGs are byte-identical in decoded RGBA/dimensions to before; ID/viewBox diagnostics equal the original geometry-rect pixels.

eventPipe.mechanism: Runtime startup EventPipe collection, standard runtime/private/sample-profiler providers; TraceEvent 3.2.5 conversion and GC allocation tick stacks.
